category_observation: The sequence-transformation and requirement-parsing cases were supported. Each of the other eight single-case categories produced insufficient evidence; one observation per category does not support statistical generalization.

development_v5_comparison.interpretation: The descriptive proportions differ, but this does not establish causality. The holdout repositories were not used for tuning, the implementation was frozen first, selection and oracle validation used no PatchProof semantic agents, the blind run occurred once, and its results did not change the evaluated implementation.

verification.pytest: 295 passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped; the sole failure is the pre-run assertion that benchmarks/holdout/results must not exist after the authorized results were created

observed_limitations: One case remained non-discriminating after a behaviorally distinct repair.
Seven cases ended environmental: three categories encountered collection errors, two encountered BASE test errors with HEAD passes, and two encountered process errors.
Eight repairs were executed, but none converted a case into discriminating evidence.
One initial candidate was rejected by deterministic import grounding before execution.

One orchestration test encodes the pre-run assumption that the results directory is absent and therefore fails after the authorized immutable results exist; it was not changed after observing the holdout.
